change.livez: FastAPI and Flask /livez now return health_payload(service, live=True, ready=True) with no metrics/details/dependencies callables; shape unchanged (status, service, timestamp, live, ready, dependencies={}, metrics={service_up:1}, details={}); status 200.
change.fastapi_threadpool: /healthz, /readyz, /metrics handlers changed from async def to def so FastAPI runs the service callables in its threadpool, off the event loop. Bodies and status codes unchanged.

freeze_reproduction.method: FastAPI app, metrics callable takes a lock held by another thread (released by a timer after 3s). A request is issued, then an asyncio.sleep(0.3) on the same loop is timed, then /livez and an unrelated /other route.
freeze_reproduction.reading: Before: the loop did not resume for 2.98s (requested 0.3s), i.e. the whole service froze. After: resumes in 0.3s and /livez and /other answer in ~2ms while the blocked metrics request is pending.
